title: AI Ink Silhouette
description: Transforms the photo into a dramatic black ink silhouette illustration.
positive_prompt: Transform the input photo into a dramatic black ink silhouette illustration. Render the subjects and scene using deep black ink shapes, crisp negative space, expressive brushwork, carefully controlled ink edges, and a minimal ivory or white background. Introduce selective dry-brush textures, delicate ink splatters, and subtle brushstroke variation without obscuring important contours. Define subjects primarily through recognizable silhouettes, hairstyle outlines, body posture, clothing profiles, and carefully placed negative-space details. Where necessary, use a few fine white ink lines to distinguish essential facial landmarks and overlapping subjects. Rendering contract: Use the input image as visual ground truth. Follow the source image exactly for exact number of subjects and their left-to-right order, relative position, scale, pose, gaze direction, interactions, camera viewpoint, composition, and scene context. For every visible person, retain recognizable face geometry, distinctive contours, and characteristic visual features within the limitations of silhouette art; do not beautify, age, or swap identity unless explicitly requested. Retain recognizable props, background shapes, and subject separation. Preserve the source aspect ratio. Apply the transformation consistently across the entire scene into a coherent high-contrast monochrome ink composition. Return one coherent finished image, not a before-and-after comparison, split screen, or unintended collage; produce one finished static illustration without readable text, typography, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, watermarks, or additional visual panels.
negative_prompt: full-color rendering, photorealistic textures, gradients, realistic skin shading, 3D modeling, cartoon facial exaggeration, muddy gray tones, uncontrolled ink splashes, obscured silhouettes, merged people, indistinguishable figures, changed pose, distorted anatomy, extra subjects, missing people, additional limbs, misplaced negative space, altered perspective, text, lettering, logos, watermarks, collage, identity drift, face swap, altered age, altered skin tone, wrong subject count, extra people, duplicated subject, merged subjects, inconsistent transformation, partial transformation, before-and-after, split screen, unintended collage, accidental crop, cut-off face, broken hands, fused fingers, extra limbs, incoherent perspective, floating objects, random text, gibberish letters, numerals, signature, interface elements
custom_prompt_placeholder: e.g. expressive brushwork, high contrast ink...
